name: Vampire Spawn

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.summary: Climbs difficult surfaces, even upside down on ceilings, with no ability check.
traits.text: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down along ceilings, without making an ability check.

traits.name: Vampire Weakness
traits.summary: Needs an invitation to enter homes; harmed by running water and sunlight; a stake can destroy it.
traits.text: The vampire has these weaknesses. Forbiddance: it can't enter a residence unless an occupant invites it in. Running Water: it takes 20 Acid damage if it ends its turn in running water. Stake to the Heart: it is destroyed if a weapon that deals Piercing damage is driven into its heart while it has the Incapacitated condition. Sunlight: it takes 20 Radiant damage if it starts its turn in sunlight, and while in sunlight it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: Makes two Claw attacks and uses Bite.

actions.name: Claw
actions.summary: Slashes a target; a Medium or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 13).
actions.text: Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) Slashing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13), held by one of the vampire's two claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.summary: DC 14 Con save by a willing, Grappled, Incapacitated or Restrained target; drains life to heal.
actions.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the Grappled, Incapacitated or Restrained condition. Failure: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. The target's Hit Point maximum is reduced by the Necrotic damage it took, and the vampire regains that many Hit Points.

bonus_actions.name: Deathless Agility
bonus_actions.summary: Takes the Dash or Disengage action.
bonus_actions.text: The vampire takes the Dash action or the Disengage action.

summary: Grabs a victim with its claws, bites to heal itself, and disengages freely; shuns sunlight.
